note: Copilot & AI #23. Nothing leaves the laptop: no tenant, no account, no key, no cloud cost. The two Ollama models are chosen on the day (one small, one too big for the 24 GB GPU) and passed in the environment variables MG_SMALL_MODEL and MG_BIG_MODEL (typed by the owner when prepare asks), so the on-screen commands show the variable names. Close other GPU-hungry apps first so the free-memory number is honest; stop both models before bench so the warm-up load time is a real cold load. Hide the Windows user name: short prompt, no paths in view. Foundry Local is optional (winget install Microsoft.FoundryLocal). A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_SMALL_MODEL) { $env:MG_SMALL_MODEL = Read-Host 'Small Ollama model (about 8B or less, from ollama list; owner types)' }
if (-not $env:MG_BIG_MODEL) { $env:MG_BIG_MODEL = Read-Host 'Big Ollama model that does not fit the GPU (owner types)' }

$env:MG_FOUNDRY_URL = if ($env:MG_FOUNDRY_URL) { $env:MG_FOUNDRY_URL } else { Read-Host 'Foundry Local base URL, http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 (foundry server status; owner types, or http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 if not installed)' }

# manual (owner): start the Ollama app/service; LM Studio: load one small model, Developer tab, Start server (or lms server start), base URL http://localhost:1234/v1; optional Foundry Local: foundry model list --device gpu, foundry chat <alias> once, keep the model running
# manual (owner): one full dry run of every command below as the safety take

screens.name: sizing
commands: ollama run $env:MG_BIG_MODEL "Reply with one word: ready"
screens.note: Real output only. The query form of nvidia-smi is used so no process paths with the Windows user name appear; say whatever GPU the machine reports (RTX 5090 Laptop, 24 GB expected). Compare the estimate with the real CPU/GPU split of ollama ps.

screens.name: bench
screens.note: Record the REAL numbers unedited. If the big model is 100% GPU as well, say so and pick a larger one before publishing.

screens.name: extract
commands: python -m local_llm extract $env:MG_SMALL_MODEL --email samples/invoice-email.txt --schema samples/invoice.schema.json --expected samples/invoice-expected.json
screens.note: Show the email first (the SYSTEM NOTE injection line and the bank-details change). Keep whatever the model really answers: a failure is a lesson, not a retake.

screens.name: probe
screens.note: One line per server (Ollama, LM Studio and, if installed, Foundry Local) with its model ids; the second command shows the non-local refusal, which fails before any network call. Skip the Foundry line if it is not installed.

teardown: # manual (owner): switch off the LM Studio server toggle; stop Foundry Local if started (check foundry --help for the stop command); ollama rm <model> for models pulled only for the recording if disk space matters
